nostr:
Nostr WoT 0.8.10 isolates a legacy website login behind one-time approval.

Kind 22242 with domain and challenge does not bind the exact URL and HTTP method required by NIP-98 kind 27235. Saved grants and backend automation cannot approve it, and two requests from one site remain two decisions.

GitHub release assets are live. Store availability is separate.
